# Afterdark Dwellings repository instructions

1. The brand name is **Afterdark Dwellings**. It is exactly two words. Never render it as "After Dark Dwellings".
2. This project is independent. Never add GRVEZ VAULT, music, artist, or unrelated brand content.
3. Preserve the dark architectural editorial aesthetic: near-black, graphite, steel, cool off-white, and restrained warm architectural light.
4. Use Cinzel-like editorial display typography sparingly and a clean sans-serif for body/UI.
5. Never fabricate products, merchants, prices, ratings, reviews, specifications, availability, or affiliate relationships.
6. Verified retailer links may be shown before affiliate approval. If an affiliate URL is later supplied, prefer it and show an appropriate disclosure.
7. Prioritize mobile usability: no horizontal scroll, cut-off navigation, giant empty hero areas, or unreadable text.
8. Guides should combine practical editorial advice, photography, contextual product recommendations, related guides, and Pinterest calls to action.
9. Keep routes and SEO metadata descriptive and stable.
10. Run `npm run build` before completing significant changes. Fix TypeScript and route errors.
11. Do not remove legal/trust pages without explicit instruction.
12. Public contact: afterdarkdwellings@gmail.com
13. Pinterest: https://www.pinterest.com/afterdarkdwellings/
